summary.one_liner: A curated awesome-list of links to articles, guides, courses and academic papers about software pricing and how to implement it.
summary.what_it_does: This is a link list rather than software. It is organized into sections: Guides and Courses, Usage Based Pricing, "The role of pricing", Other, Academic Papers, and a Contribute section pointing to contribution guidelines. The entries are article and course titles, mostly about SaaS pricing models, packaging, usage-based billing, and price optimization. Academic papers cover pricing strategy's effect on valuation, dynamic pricing, and FinTech pricing decisions. The README gives no descriptions beyond titles, so the list does not summarize or rate the linked resources. It points to priceops.org for more on the PriceOps topic and says PRs are welcome.
